prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Osmium (Os) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves, reading desks and big windows
Hair: her hair in a single loose braid over one shoulder — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: a low warm light source near her — a lamp, a fire or a screen — glowing on her from below shoulder height.
Outfit: a flowing ballroom gown with a fitted bodice — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, rust, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; back to the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; she is small in the lower part of the frame, the place rising above her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a small blue-white osmium pellet, startlingly heavy for its size, resting in her palm low at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — osmium: a hard, brittle blue-white metal, the densest natural element at about 22.6 grams per cubic centimetre, twice as heavy as lead and rivalled only by iridium; found in 1803 together with iridium in the black residue left after platinum dissolves in aqua regia, and named from the Greek word for smell because its volatile oxide gives off a sharp, chlorine-like stench; that oxide vapour stains fats black and has long been used to reveal the shapes of cells under the microscope; its hard alloys once tipped fountain-pen nibs and gramophone needles — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: user authorized publishing; preserve generated image without regeneration

observations: 1024x1536 confirmed; one adult woman in focus; painted anime finish.
Figure turns toward viewer despite rear-facing walking plan; environmental library and small metal pellet visible.
